mapper.select: SELECT t.user_id AS userId, ( SELECT n.create_name FROM ai_conversation_turn n WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND n.user_id = t.user_id AND n.create_name IS NOT NULL AND n.create_name != '' AND n.create_time >= #{startTime} AND n.create_time < #{endTime} ORDER BY n.create_time DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS userName, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.role = 'ASSISTANT' THEN COALESCE(t.input_tokens, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.role = 'ASSISTANT' THEN COALESCE(t.output_tokens, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.role = 'ASSISTANT' THEN COALESCE(t.input_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(t.output_tokens, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalTokens, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.role = 'USER' THEN 1 END) AS conversationCount FROM ai_conversation_turn t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL AND t.create_time >= #{startTime} AND t.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY t.user_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN t.role = 'USER' THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY conversationCount DESC, totalTokens DESC, t.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
